info.title: Hypotize API
info.summary: Growth experiments for agents and automations.
info.description:
Read and write the growth experiments of your Hypotize projects: ideas, tests, outcomes and learnings.

Authenticate with a personal API key (Settings, API keys) sent as `Authorization: Bearer hyp_...`. A Read only key can call the GET endpoints; a Read and write key can also call the others.

Errors use real HTTP status codes and one body shape: `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`, sometimes with extra fields such as `required_roles` or the import row that failed.

- 400 INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_JSON, INVALID_CURSOR, INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY and the lifecycle codes (EXPERIMENT_NOT_READY, OUTCOME_REQUIRED...)
- 401 UNAUTHORIZED: missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key
- 403 FORBIDDEN (the key's access level is too low) or INSUFFICIENT_ROLE (the project role is too low, with required_roles)
- 404 NOT_FOUND
- 409 STALE_EXPERIMENT (expected_updated_at is not the current updated_at) or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED
- 429 RATE_LIMITED: 300 requests a minute per key, 500 written rows every 5 minutes

Writes accept an `Idempotency-Key` header: a retry with the same key and body within 24 hours returns the first response, with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Lists are paginated with `cursor`: pass `next_cursor` from the previous page until it is null.

The same operations are available to AI agents on the MCP server at https://api.hypotize.ai/mcp.

get.description: Projects the API key's user can access, across workspaces, with the user's role and permissions.
One project with its framework, settings and the user's role.

Experiments of a project, Ideas included, most recently updated first. Filter by status, funnel stage, tags or updated_after.

For a polling trigger, pass updated_after with the time of the last poll and dedupe on id plus updated_at.

post.description: Adds a new experiment idea to the project backlog.
Imports up to 50 existing experiments, at any stage, in one atomic call: one invalid row rolls back the batch, and the error names it.

get.description: One experiment with its hypothesis, metrics, scores, variants, outcome and comments.

patch.description: Changes the fields in the body. expected_updated_at must match the experiment's current updated_at, or the call returns 409.

schema.description: The fields to change, plus expected_updated_at: the experiment's current updated_at.

post.summary: Move an experiment to a stage
post.description: Moves the experiment to another pipeline stage, such as Running or Analyzing.
Records the result, what happened and the learning, and closes the experiment.
Adds a dated comment to the experiment. It does not change the experiment updated_at.

get.description:
Experiment outcomes and learnings, most recently updated first. With ended_after, experiments without an end date are left out.

For a polling trigger, read the first page (most recently updated first) and dedupe on experiment_id plus updated_at. Do not poll with ended_after: an outcome recorded later keeps the earlier end date and would be missed.
